propositions: The test monkeypatch `observed_upsert` closure has a narrower signature than the real `CriterionBank.upsert`, missing keyword-only params `evidence_sufficient` and `seeded`.

When production code calls `upsert(..., evidence_sufficient=False)` via the bounded-fallback path (`record_insufficient`), the narrow stub raises TypeError; this surfaces only on the bedrock arm because anthropic/openai arms gather sufficient evidence and never hit the fallback.

The fix threads all keyword arguments through the test stub via `**kwargs` so `evidence_sufficient`, `seeded`, and future kwargs are forwarded unchanged to the real `upsert`, preserving signal and eliminating the TypeError.

A shared, live-dep-free helper `make_observed_upsert` in `tests/_bank_observer.py` extracts the bookkeeping stub and is used by both the live external eval and a fast unit regression to validate kwarg forwarding.
After the fix, the completion verifier test runs to verdict with `error=None` and all criteria banked, and the TypeError no longer occurs.
